name: Modular
summary: A fully disassemblable crane that mates orbiter to booster anywhere — it moves with the fleet, not the pad.
description: TX-03 Modular is a transportable, fully disassemblable assembly crane that mates orbiter to booster. It travels with the fleet (carried by LX-22 or MX vehicles) so stacks can be built at any base rather than a fixed launch complex. Roster-level entry only.
